column2: the plan’s testing strategy asserts plr0911 guidance on the rendered lint-fix prompt but does not pin it to `$lint_shared_prompt` (`_compose_prompt` output). the harness already splits `$lint_shared_prompt` (claude/cursor/claude-first lint-fix tiers) from combined `$lint_prompt` (shared + codex appendix) and uses `assert_not_contains` on shared for codex-only markers. if plr0911 text is placed only in `_codex_lint_fix_prompt_appendix`, combined-prompt assertions still pass while claude and cursor lint-fix paths miss consolidation guidance, partially failing the issue goal and allowing step6 main-agent-required escalation on the first waterfall tier.

on step6, `run-relevant` logs `python/cli.py lint complexity-baseline` plus lines like `gh.py:pr_checks_not_ready_detail plr0911 (new)`. `_is_complexity_baseline_regression_log` matches that log and `_run_lint_fix_impl` returns `main-agent-required` before `_compose_prompt` runs, so external lint-fix coders and the new plr0911 section never execute. that is the exact escalation in the issue; only the implementer-base bullet remains if prevention fails.
